components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a screen or card.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:44px; padding:0 20px; border:none; border-radius:12px; background:#0a8079; color:#fff; font:600 14px/1 Inter, Cairo, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(10,128,121,0.2); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#0d6662; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #0a8079; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(.98); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Second choice beside a primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height:44px; padding:0 20px; border:1px solid #7f95c9; border-radius:12px; background:#fff; color:#15234a; font:600 14px/1 Inter, Cairo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .2s, border-color .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:#eef2f9; border-color:#536faf; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #0a8079; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform:scale(.98); }

components.name: Navy Button
components.css: .ds-btn-navy { height:44px; padding:0 20px; border:none; border-radius:12px; background:#15234a; color:#fff; font:600 14px/1 Inter, Cairo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-btn-navy:hover { background:#0d1733; } .ds-btn-navy:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #0a8079; } .ds-btn-navy:active { transform:scale(.98); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled input with teal focus and red error state.
components.css: .ds-field { display:block; font:500 14px/1.4 Inter, Cairo, system-ui, sans-serif; color:#15234a; } .ds-field span { display:block; margin-bottom:6px; } .ds-field input { width:100%; padding:10px 14px; border:1px solid #7f95c9; border-radius:12px; background:#fff; color:#0d1733; font:400 14px Inter, Cairo, system-ui, sans-serif; transition:border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:#536faf; } .ds-field input:focus { outline:none; border-color:#0a8079; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(10,128,121,.4); }

components.name: Filter Chips
components.description: Pill filters; selected is solid navy.
components.css: .ds-chips { display:flex; gap:8px; } .ds-chip { min-height:40px; padding:6px 14px; border:1px solid #7f95c9; border-radius:9999px; background:#fff; color:#1d3061; font:500 14px Inter, Cairo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .2s, background-color .2s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:#536faf; } .ds-chip-on { background:#15234a; border-color:#15234a; color:#fff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #0a8079; }

components.css: .ds-card { max-width:340px; padding:20px; border:1px solid #eef2f9; border-radius:16px; background:#fff; font-family:Inter, Cairo, system-ui, sans-serif; color:#0d1733; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(13,23,51,0.06), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(13,23,51,0.15); transition:transform .3s, box-shadow .3s; } .ds-card:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 10px 30px -12px rgba(13,23,51,0.18); } .ds-card-tags { display:flex; gap:8px; } .ds-tag { padding:2px 8px; border-radius:6px; background:#effcfa; color:#0d6662; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; } .ds-match { padding:2px 8px; border-radius:6px; background:#15234a; color:#fff; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; } .ds-card h3 { margin:6px 0 0; font-size:16px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.375; } .ds-card p { margin:0; color:#365294; font-size:14px; } .ds-card-foot { display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:20px; padding-top:16px; border-top:1px solid #eef2f9; } .ds-card-foot button { flex:1; height:40px; border-radius:12px; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; font-family:inherit; cursor:pointer; } .ds-card-ghost { border:1px solid #7f95c9; background:#fff; color:#1d3061; } .ds-card-go { border:none; background:#0a8079; color:#fff; transition:background-color .2s; } .ds-card-go:hover { background:#0d6662; } .ds-card-foot button:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #0a8079; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sticky blurred header with teal-mist active link.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; height:64px; padding:0 16px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.9); backdrop-filter:blur(8px); border-bottom:1px solid #d5def0; font-family:Inter, Cairo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong { margin-inline-end:16px; color:#0d1733; } .ds-nav a { padding:8px 12px; border-radius:8px; color:#273f78; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-nav a:hover { background:#eef2f9; color:#0d1733; } .ds-nav a.ds-nav-on { background:#effcfa; color:#0d6662; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #0a8079; }

components.css: .ds-progress { width:280px; height:8px; border-radius:9999px; background:#d5def0; overflow:hidden; } .ds-progress div { height:100%; border-radius:9999px; background:#0fa094; transition:width .7s ease-out; }

narrative.overview:
SkillBridge carries a student from the university side to the job side, and every screen should feel like part of that crossing. Navy is the solid ground: the night sky of the inner page headers, the weight of headings, the steady text. Teal is the way forward: the action buttons, the active nav link, the progress bars and match rings that show how far across the student has come. The two colours meet in the hero, where the highlighted words fade from teal into navy.

The feel is young and lively without being loud. Cards lift a little when you point at them, sections fade up as they arrive, soft teal and navy glows sit blurred behind headers, and rounded corners keep everything friendly. The energy comes from motion and from teal moments, never from new colours. Density stays comfortable: one clear action per card, generous padding, short labels.

Arabic is a first-class citizen. Arabic pages switch to Cairo, the whole layout mirrors right-to-left through logical properties (`start`/`end`), and letter-spacing is switched off for Arabic text because Arabic letters join.
keyCharacteristics: Navy and teal only for brand colour; red and amber appear only for meaning (errors, ratings).
Soft, lifted white cards on a pale slate page.
Rounded, friendly geometry: 12px buttons and inputs, 16px cards, full pills for chips and badges.
Motion that rewards: hover lifts, fade-up entrances, progress that fills smoothly, all switched off under reduced motion.
Bilingual by construction: Inter for English, Cairo for Arabic, mirrored layout.

rules.name: The Two-Colour Rule
rules.body: Brand colour is navy or teal, nothing else. No purple, orange, pink or new accents for decoration. Red and amber are allowed only when they carry meaning (an error, a rating, a demo warning).

rules.name: The Teal Means Forward Rule
rules.body: Teal marks the next step: the button to press, the progress made, the link you are on. If something teal is not an action or a sign of progress, it should be navy.

rules.name: The No Tracking in Arabic Rule
rules.body: Any letter-spacing is removed under `dir="rtl"`. Arabic letters connect; spacing them breaks the words.

rules.name: The Lift on Intent Rule
rules.body: Things a student can open lift on hover (cards rise, course images zoom 5%); static containers stay still.

dos: **Do** use Bridge Teal for the one main action on each card or screen, and navy or outline for the rest.
**Do** give every interactive element the 2px teal focus ring with a 2px offset.
**Do** use logical properties (`start`/`end`) and flip directional icons so Arabic mirrors correctly.
**Do** let cards lift on hover and sections fade up; keep it lively but quick (0.2–0.6s).
**Do** keep touch targets at least 40px tall.
donts: **Don't** introduce any brand colour outside navy and teal (the owner's explicit rule).
**Don't** use red or amber for decoration; they mean error and rating only.
**Don't** use pure black text or black shadows; text is Midnight Navy and shadows are navy-tinted.
**Don't** add motion that ignores `prefers-reduced-motion`; the global rule turns animation off and must stay.
